El artista Ana Bianchi está en una misión para ayudar a las personas a usar el color con confianza en cualquier práctica creativa. Este libro lúdico y altamente visual le invita a refrescar su relación al color observando el mundo a su alrededor. de'longhi - classic espresso machine - s.description: Italian design meets exceptional espresso with the De'Longhi Classic. Bringing you simplicity and quality for all your café favorites at home, from lattes and cappuccinos to iced caramel macchiatos, espresso martinis and more, it's the perfect fit for any kitchen countertop. Achieve expertly pulled shots of espresso with a consistent 9-bar high pressure extraction and an auto-stop function, for your favorite drinks. The chrome-detailed visual pressure gauge tracks the pressure in real time, providing an easy visual cue resulting in the perfect brew. And instantly reach the perfect temperature, thanks to Thermoblock technology, providing fast, precise and stable temperature control. Equally matched with quality and simplicity is versatility with the De'Longhi Classic, with its customizable single or double espresso one-touch preset recipes to start brewing your preferred dose automatically, along with an adjustable steam wand with two settings to effortlessly froth milk and alternatives from silky steamed milk, to rich & velvety frothed milk. The double height trip tray can be easily adjusted to fit a wide variety of your preferred glassware from espresso to larger latte glasses, and everything in between. Craft café-quality drinks with simplicity & style at home with the De'Longhi Classic espresso machine.
